name: Game on Games
source:
Video games are your whole world. Too bad that, in the blink of an eye, they’ve vanished from the face of the earth!

Alongside your loyal friend Zen, and guided by the researcher Lisa and the mysterious Professor, it is up to you to rediscover video games and help others discover them too, starting with your own personal experience!

[Translated from [url=https://giuliach.itch.io/game-on-games]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
电子游戏就是你的整个世界。可惜转眼之间，它们竟从地球上彻底消失得无影无踪！

在忠实好友禅的陪伴下，并在研究员莉萨与神秘博士的指引下，你需要从自身的亲身经历出发，重新找回电子游戏的踪迹，并带领世人再度领略它们的魅力！

[译自[url=https://giuliach.itch.io/game-on-games]itch.io[/url]]
